runtime: CPU bigint Prime256Party; four real TLS roles

numerical.evaluation: All eight tokens are training examples; no held-out accuracy claim.

range_proof.contract: Public bound across all 8 one-hot inputs; no private domain check.

measurement: Actual shared-host four-process CPU/TLS latency including all checks and final opening; not a GPU or perfect-network estimate.

clear_baselines.model: actual trained Linear(8,2), square, Linear(2,8) in PyTorch inference mode

provisioning: Shared-host functional fixture; deployment requires private execution domains and authenticated confidential channels. Each worker reads only its own claimed native role bundle and owner-assigned plaintext inputs.

pipeline_cost.formula: crypto_batch_ms / distinct_single_use_query_packs + fresh_model_preparation_ms + new_input_sharing_ms + checked_query_ms + static_model_sharing_ms / model_queries
pipeline_cost.reuse_contract: Each query consumes its own fresh correlations and E/F preparation; only static model sharing is reusable.
pipeline_cost.timing_context: Actual native fresh generation plus CPU/TLS sharing and checked query; compilation separate; one fresh correlation pack, no replay amortization.
